title: 第3章
slug: 鍏堝氬悗鐖澶у彅鎴戞墠鎴愬勾
content_zh: 扔他一把零钱被子滑下来她没察觉，顾墨看见那娇小的肩膀上，斑斑点点的，惨不忍睹，全部都是他弄的吗？顿时脸上闪过一抹不自在。司绵见他在看自己，低头就看见自己暴露了一点点，立刻拉起被子，绝对不要便宜他，随即又劈头盖脸的骂过去，“看什么看，再看把你眼睛挖出来当灯泡踩”顾墨轻咳了两声，收回视线，转身捞起外套穿上。司绵趁这个时候，快速捡起地上的衣服，躲在被子窸窸窣窣的动作着，穿好衣服后，掀开被子踩在地上，立刻疼得她龇牙咧嘴的。该死的，不知道她是第一次啊，竟然那么用力。司绵看着他的背影，精瘦而不失肌肉，一不小心就看呆了。他转身，两人的视线刚好对在一起，司绵立刻回神，心里懊恼的要死，都什么时候，她还有心情欣赏美色。卡她必须收下，这样他们两个才能两清，谁都不欠谁，虽然昨晚她给他的滋味很美妙，但是对于他来说，她还太小，不适合他。而且这样的人碰了，是个麻烦，还是少惹为妙。“卡你收好，以后…”顾墨话还没说完，司绵就截住了他的话，要甩都要她先甩，清白已经没了，再哭再闹也不可能时光倒流。这个时候，气势要拿足，输人不输阵。“我告诉你，昨晚的事情我就当被狗咬了，不准缠着我，踏出这道门，我们谁都不认识谁”说完，她昂了昂头，除了眼睛红红之外，气色十分不错，脸颊红扑扑的。顾墨怔了一下，她到是会抢话，把他要说的都说了。不过只要以后谁都别碍着谁，就让她一次。“希望你能说到做到”司绵瞪了他一眼，把那张银行卡拿起来揣在包包里，那种为了尊严而不要钱的苦情女人，不太合适她。清白已经白白给他了，再不要钱，那不是傻子吗？这就当是各种赔偿费，不过自己单方面收了他的钱，那不就是他嫖自己吗？不行。司绵快速从口袋里掏出一把钱，顿时有点暴汗，太屌丝了，连一张二十元的大钞票都没有，全部都是一元、五角、一毛的。管它的，先把他震住再说。她走到他的跟前，扯开他的领口，把一把零钱塞进去，“哼，昨晚你的表现也就这点价值，记住，昨晚是我嫖你，敢把这件事泄露出去，我就告诉全世界，你是鸭子，而且还是技术不行的鸭子”说完，不待顾墨反应撒腿就跑了，当门关上的那一刻，司绵才松了一口气。顾墨低头就看见胸口处塞了满满的零钱，额头挂满黑线，真亏她想得出来。真要敢瞟他，早被抓进局子里面去出不来了。司绵一口气跑出酒店，躲到旁边咖啡厅的厕所里去，累死她了，坐在马桶上大口的喘气。身上除了一张卡，一文钱也没有，早知道就不给他那么多钱了，好歹也留一块钱给自己坐车啊。现在好了，附近又没有银行，她去那里取钱啊。现在就算再喜欢年修仁，她也不搞什么献身的戏码了，她真是小说看多了，脑袋被门卡了，才会做出这样的事情来。司绵现在是后悔的要死。回家的路上，却不想遇到了那个称之为父亲，却没有尽过父亲责任的人。司大伟看见她，脸上堆起笑脸凑上来，“绵绵啊，我是爸爸，最近身体好不好啊，升职了没？我记得每个月的月底，你发工资是不是？”“爸，我现在只是实习生，去工作就是为了学习经验，跟白打工没什么两样，那有什么升职的机会，而且我没钱”司大伟拉着她的手，脸上有着讨好，“绵绵啊，你后爸不是有钱吗？他不给你零花钱用啊，你就救济一下你爸爸我呗，我两天没吃饭了，你忍心看爸爸饿死啊”看见司大伟眼里的贪婪，司绵心里很是不舒服，她记得小时候，爸爸不是这样的，但是不知从什么时候，爸妈开始不停的争吵，每次都是为了钱。最后妈受不了爸了，两人离婚了，而她跟着妈。“爸，我有手有脚，没理由拿我后爸的钱，我现在真的身无分文，而且我只是一个拖油瓶，你还真以为我在那个家是小姐命啊，钱多到花不完”本来发生昨晚那件事，她的心情就够糟糕的了，现在又遇到这件事情，她连烦躁都没力气了。在那个家，自己在外的花费，她都尽量自己挣，不拿苏家的钱，所以她一点存款都没有。“绵绵啊，你想想办法好不好，要不，你问你妈妈要点，就当是爸爸借的，等爸爸找到工作了，立刻还给你”“爸，我真的没办法，你还是另想办法吧”司大伟着急了，说着就要跪下来，司绵瞪大了眼睛，立刻扶住他，“爸，你这是干什么？你起来啊，这样像什么话”“这次你无论如何都要帮爸爸啊，不然爸爸真的就走投无路了”司大伟眼睛都红了，一副凄惨的摸样。虽然他再不对，毕竟还是自己的爸爸，看见他老泪纵横，司绵心里酸酸的，她真的无法拒绝。“走吧，我去银行取点钱给你”等司绵拿出银行卡的时候，司大伟一把抢过去，看见上面还贴着密码，顿时眼睛一亮，“绵绵啊，卡爸爸就先替你保管了，这钱算爸爸借你的，以后一定还给你，就这样，我先走了”说完，司大伟就急匆匆的走了，看见他头也不回的离去，司绵心里抽痛。就这是她的亲生父亲，连卡都拿走了，没想过她以后要怎么过日子。司绵觉得身心疲惫，她拖着步子往苏家走去，苏家是组合家庭，妈妈带着她嫁给过，后爸已经有了一个儿子和女儿，年纪都跟她差不多。女儿苏心很早就被送出国留学了，一年难得回来几次，所以司绵跟苏颂相处的时间很多。而妈妈忙着讨好儿子，时常忘记了，她还有一个女儿叫司绵。不过幸好她性格外向，不然就这样的生长环境，不得抑郁症才怪。
content_en: She threw him a handful of change and the quilt slid down without her noticing. Gu Mo saw that the petite shoulders were covered in spots and were horrible to look at. Was it all caused by him? Suddenly a flash of discomfort flashed across his face. Seeing him looking at her, Si Mian lowered his head and saw that he was a little exposed. He immediately pulled up the quilt and never took advantage of him. Then he scolded him, "What are you looking at? If you look at me again, I will dig out your eyes and step on them like light bulbs." Gu Mo coughed twice, looked away, turned around, picked up his coat and put it on. Si Mian took advantage of this moment to quickly pick up the clothes on the ground, hiding under the quilt and making rustling movements. After putting on the clothes, he lifted the quilt and stepped on the ground. She immediately grimaced in pain. Damn it, I didn’t know it was her first time, but she was so hard. Si Mian looked at his back, lean yet muscular, and was stunned by it. He turned around, and their eyes met. Si Mian immediately came back to his senses, feeling extremely annoyed. How long had she still been in the mood to appreciate beauty? She had to accept the card so that the two of them could be reconciled and no one owed anything to the other. Although the taste she gave him last night was wonderful, she was still too young for him and not suitable for him. Moreover, if you encounter such a person, it will be troublesome, so it is better not to deal with it as much as possible. "Put the card away. Later..." Before Gu Mo could finish his words, Si Mian intercepted him. If he wanted to dump him, she had to dump him first. His innocence was gone. No matter how much he cried or made trouble, he couldn't turn back time. At this time, the momentum must be sufficient, and the formation will not lose even if the opponent loses. "Let me tell you, what happened last night is like being bitten by a dog. You are not allowed to pester me. No one of us knows each other when we step out of this door." After saying that, she raised her head. Apart from her red eyes, she looked very good and her cheeks were rosy. Gu Mo was startled for a moment. She knew how to grab the conversation and said everything he wanted to say. But as long as no one gets in the way in the future, let her do it once. "I hope you can keep your word." Si Mian glared at him, picked up the bank card and put it in his bag. The kind of bitter woman who doesn't want money for the sake of dignity is not suitable for her. His innocence has been given to him for free. If he doesn't want any more money, wouldn't he be a fool? This is regarded as various compensation fees, but if I unilaterally collected his money, wouldn't that mean that he was prostituted to me? no. Si Mian quickly took out a handful of money from his pocket and suddenly felt a little sweaty. He was so stupid that he didn't even have a twenty-yuan bill. They were all one yuan, fifty cents, and dimes. Who cares, just shock him first. She walked up to him, pulled open his collar, and stuffed a handful of change into it, "Huh, your performance last night is only worth this. Remember, I was the one who prostituted you last night. If you dare to leak this matter, I will tell the world that you are a duck, and a duck with poor skills." After saying that, she ran away without waiting for Gu Mo's reaction. When the door closed, Si Mian breathed a sigh of relief. Gu Mo lowered his head and saw that his chest was stuffed full of change, and his forehead was covered with black lines. It was a shame she could think of it. If he really dared to glance at him, he would have been arrested and unable to get out. Si Mian ran out of the hotel in one breath and hid in the toilet of the nearby cafe. She was so exhausted that she sat on the toilet and gasped for air. Apart from a card, I didn't have a penny on my body. If I had known better, I wouldn't have given him so much money. At least I still had a dollar left for me to take the bus. It's fine now. There's no bank nearby, so she can go there to withdraw money. Now even if she likes Nian Xiuren, she won't engage in any drama of devotion. She has read too many novels and her head is stuck, so she would do such a thing. Si Mian regretted it to death now. On the way home, I didn't want to meet the man who I called my father but who failed to fulfill his father's responsibilities. When Si Dawei saw her, he came over with a smile on his face, "Mianmian, I'm dad. How are you doing recently? Have you been promoted? I remember at the end of every month, you get paid, right?" "Dad, I'm just an intern now. I go to work just to learn experience. It's no different from working for free. What chance of promotion are there, and I have no money?" Si Dawei held her hand, with a smile on his face. Trying to please her, "Mianmian, isn't your stepfather rich? He won't give you pocket money, so why don't you give me some relief for your father? I haven't eaten for two days, you can't bear to see your father starve to death." Seeing the greed in Si Dawei's eyes, Si Mian felt very uncomfortable. She remembered that her father was not like this when she was a child, but at some point, her parents began to quarrel non-stop, always over money. In the end, my mother couldn't stand my father anymore, they divorced, and she stayed with her mother. "Dad, I have hands and feet. There is no reason to take my stepfather's money. I am really penniless now, and I am just a dragster. Do you really think that I am a young lady in that family? There is too much money to spend." She was in a bad mood after what happened last night, but now that this happened again, she didn't even have the energy to be upset. In that family, she tried her best to earn her own expenses outside the home without taking any money from the Su family, so she had no savings at all. "Mianmian, can you think of a way? How about you ask your mother for some tips and treat it as if it was borrowed by dad. When dad finds a job, I will return it to you immediately." "Dad, I really can't help it. You should find another way." Si Dawei was anxious and was about to kneel down as he spoke. , Si Mian's eyes widened, and he immediately supported him, "Dad, what are you doing? Get up, what are you talking about?" "You have to help dad no matter what this time, otherwise dad will really be cornered." Si Dawei's eyes were red, looking miserable. No matter how wrong he was, he was still her father after all. Seeing him burst into tears made Si Mian feel sour. She really couldn't refuse. "Let's go, I'll go to the bank to get some money for you." When Si Mian took out the bank card, Si Dawei grabbed it and saw the password on it. His eyes suddenly lit up, "Mianmian, daddy will keep the card for you first, and daddy will lend you this money."
novel_title: 先婚后爱,大叔,我才成年
